mapper.select: select project_id, node_total, node_finish_total, node_delay_total, action_finish_total, action_delay_total, action_total, ROUND((node_finish_total / node_total) * 100, 2) as node_finish_rate, ROUND((node_delay_total / node_total) * 100, 2) as node_delay_rate, ROUND((action_finish_total / action_total) * 100, 2) as action_finish_rate, ROUND((action_delay_total / action_total) * 100, 2) as action_delay_rate from ( select project_id, count(1) as node_total, sum(case when action_finish_total = action_total then 1 else 0 end) as node_finish_total, sum(case when action_delay_total > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as node_delay_total, sum(action_finish_total) as action_finish_total, sum(action_delay_total) as action_delay_total, sum(action_total) as action_total from ( select project_id, node_id, count(1) as action_total, sum(case when action_state = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as action_finish_total, sum(case when action_state in (2, 4) then 1 else 0 end) as action_delay_total from `mes3_project_management_action` where del_flag = 0 and create_time like concat(#{year}, '%') group by project_id, node_id ) t group by project_id ) t

select project_id, month, count(1) as monthTotal from ( select project_id, DATE_FORMAT(${column}, '%Y-%c') as month from mes3_project_management_action where del_flag = 0 AND ${column} >= concat(#{year}, '-01-01') AND ${column} < DATE_ADD(concat(#{year}, '-12-31'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ${column} IS NOT NULL ) a group by project_id, month
